recognize_zh: 單一視野內擠滿各成熟階段的顆粒球：髓細胞、腎形核的後髓細胞、帶狀核與分葉核（標2–5、7、8），中央還有一個充滿深紫黑色粗顆粒的嗜鹼性球（標6），這種「髓細胞＋嗜鹼性球增多」的組合是CML周邊血液的典型表現。
features: Marked granulocytic leukocytosis with the full spectrum of maturation in one field: myelocytes, metamyelocytes, bands and segmented neutrophils
Metamyelocytes and bands (labeled 2, 3) with kidney- or horseshoe-shaped nuclei and clumped chromatin
Myelocytes (labeled 5, 7) with round eccentric nuclei and abundant granular cytoplasm
Basophil (labeled 6) with coarse dark purple-black granules obscuring the nucleus
Maturing granulocytes lack overt dysplasia (normal granulation and nuclear segmentation)
Background red cells with mild poikilocytosis and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked leukocytosis composed of granulocytes at all stages of maturation, with numerous myelocytes, metamyelocytes and band forms in addition to segmented neutrophils. A basophil is present, and the granulocytes lack significant dysplastic features. Blasts are not evident in this field. Findings are consistent with chronic myeloid leukemia, BCR::ABL1-positive, in chronic phase; confirmation by BCR::ABL1 FISH/RT-PCR is required.

ddx.vs: Reactive neutrophilia is dominated by segmented and band neutrophils with toxic changes and lacks the myelocyte bulge and absolute basophilia seen here.
Atypical CML shows dysgranulopoiesis and minimal basophilia, whereas the granulocytes here are morphologically normal with a basophil present.
CNL shows mature segmented neutrophils with fewer than 10% immature granulocytes and a CSF3R mutation, not a myelocyte-rich left shift.
PMF gives a leukoerythroblastic smear with teardrop cells and nucleated red cells, usually without this degree of granulocytic leukocytosis, and lacks BCR::ABL1.
